criteria.evidence: Switching from spreadsheets to a new tool requires workflow change for the finance/ops team
Depends on UNCONFIRMED hypothesis that teams will adopt CSV-export workflow without needing API integrations — founder believes export workflow is already habitual but no confirmation
Core workflow maps onto existing behavior: download CSV from each processor, upload to dashboard — less disruptive than tools requiring new integrations or new credentials
Teams already export CSVs manually — the tool replaces the spreadsheet step, not the export step

assumptions_relied_on.text: Finance teams already export CSVs from processors habitually — upload workflow requires no new behavior
assumptions_relied_on.impact: If confirmed, Score 4 criterion would PASS, raising score from 3 to 4

key_signals: Upload-based workflow maps onto existing CSV export habits
No new integrations or credentials required for core flow
Replacing spreadsheet step (not export step) reduces behavior delta
analysis_narrative:
Behavior change is moderate — better than most new-category tools but not frictionless. The CSV-upload workflow is a strength here: it does not require OAuth integrations, API keys, or installing browser extensions. Teams that already export CSVs from Stripe and PayPal (which most do for expense reporting) simply redirect those exports to a new destination.

The behavior change is focused on the matching and reporting step, replacing an existing spreadsheet workflow. Replacing an existing workflow is generally easier than creating a new one — teams already have the habit, the tool just needs to be better than the current solution at the specific task.

Score 5 would require a completely invisible workflow change (automatic sync with zero user action), which would require API-level integration. The CSV-upload model sits at Score 3-4 depending on whether the existing CSV export habit is confirmed.
key_finding: Behavior change required is moderate — the CSV-upload workflow maps onto existing processor export habits, but replacing a spreadsheet workflow still requires a conscious switch.
score_explanation: Score 3 reflects that the core workflow builds on existing behavior (CSV exports) but still requires users to change their reconciliation step from spreadsheets to a new tool. Score 4 is achievable if confirmed that the CSV export habit is already established and habitual.
